content:
Let \(k\) be the number of angles less than \(150^\circ\). The sum of interior angles is  
\[
(2017-2)180^\circ = 2015\cdot 180^\circ.
\]
Since the other \(2017-k\) angles are strictly less than \(180^\circ\),
\[
2015\cdot 180^\circ < k\cdot 150^\circ + (2017-k)\cdot 180^\circ.
\]
Thus
\[
2015\cdot 180 < 180\cdot 2017 - 30k,
\]
so
\[
30k < 360 \implies k < 12.
\]
Hence \(k\le 11\).

This bound is attainable: take 11 angles just below \(150^\circ\) and the remaining 2006 angles just below \(180^\circ\), with total sum \(2015\cdot 180^\circ\).

\[
\boxed{11}
\]
